title: Remove dead runner-policy knobs from .tick/config.json (PolicyConfig)
description: After chz, internal/config PolicyConfig fields (MaxAttempts, Sandbox, SecretsExposure, RequireCommit, …) have no caller outside internal/config. They were runner policy; ticfac owns that now. Remove them, keep loading an old config.json that still carries them (ignore the keys), and note it in CHANGELOG.
acceptance_criteria: No PolicyConfig field without a caller remains; a test loads a config.json carrying the old keys without error; go test -short ./... passes.
